name: Rex Blanc
source:
Likes: Rules, super sweet shortcakes
Dislikes: Phantom thief
Hobbies: Visiting sweet shops
Skills: Excellent reasoning, fast reading

"I have loved you since our first meeting..."

Nox: Rex, just like me, used to be a Night Class Prefect when he was a student.
We graduated together. Now he's working at the Ministry's Reference Department.
Putting it simply, he's my rival.
He knows a lot about the stolen magical tools, so he's been assigned to this investigation along with me.
Still, with those reasoning skills of his, can he be just a regular worker of the Reference Department?

[Official in-game description]
